# My World@Mail.Ru

> A Russian social networking platform connecting classmates and friends with integrated media, gaming, and community features.

My World@Mail.Ru is Mail.Ru's flagship social network serving Russian-speaking users with a comprehensive ecosystem of social features, content streaming, and entertainment. The platform emphasizes community groups, user-generated content, and integrated media services including video hosting and music streaming.

## Key Topics

- My World@Mail.Ru
- Mail.Ru
- Social Network
- Russian Social Media
- Community Groups

- Entertainment
- Classmates & Friends
- Mail.Ru Platform

## Core Platform

- [My World@Mail.Ru: stay in touch with your classmates and friends](https://my.mail.ru): My World homepage - Mail.Ru social network for connecting with classmates and friends
- [Группы на Мой Мир@Mail.Ru](https://my.mail.ru/my/communities): Community groups directory covering humor, sports, films, music and relationships
- [Мир - My World Groups](https://my.mail.ru/community/mir): Popular community group with 287k members sharing entertainment and user content

## Media & Entertainment

- [Video Mail.Ru](https://my.mail.ru/video): Video hosting and streaming platform integrated with My World social network
- [Музыка Mail.Ru – слушать лучшую музыку онлайн](https://my.mail.ru/music): Music streaming service with artist catalogs, playlists and popular tracks
- [Каталог игр и приложений - Мой Мир@Mail.Ru](https://my.mail.ru/apps): Game and application catalog featuring strategy, casual and multiplayer games
